name: kronikol
description: Kronikol: debug a dotnet test run from its report, without opening the report.

plugins.name: kronikol
plugins.description: Debug a dotnet test run from its Kronikol report without opening it: why the tests failed (the failures digest), what a service actually returned, where a wrong value came from, what changed between runs, what was slow. Reads the report an xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, TUnit, Reqnroll or LightBDD run wrote, through the kronikol query CLI, so a 10 MB TestRunReport.json costs an agent a few hundred tokens instead of its whole context.
